title: Taxonomy and Analysis of Sensitive User Queries in Generative AI Search System
measurement_description: The paper categorizes and measures the distribution of sensitive user queries in a real-world generative AI search system. Religion is specifically evaluated as a sub-category of 'Discrimination' (queries promoting hatred or discrimination based on religion) and analyzed in the context of belief-based discrimination queries triggered by the Israel-Hamas conflict.
findings: Religion is identified as a protected attribute within the 'Discrimination' category of the proposed sensitive query taxonomy. The study found that real-world queries related to discrimination based on beliefs and controversial factuality saw a significant, measurable surge in proportion during major social events involving religious and geopolitical conflicts, such as the Israel-Hamas war.
